core_entities.name: Child
core_entities.description: A child enrolled in the daycare, with personal details, medical information, and guardian contacts.

core_entities.name: Guardian
core_entities.description: A parent or legal guardian responsible for a child, with contact and payment details.

core_entities.name: Staff
core_entities.description: An employee of the daycare, such as a teacher or administrator, with role and schedule information.

core_entities.name: Classroom
core_entities.description: A group or room where children are assigned, managed by staff, with capacity and age range.

core_entities.name: AttendanceRecord
core_entities.description: Tracks daily check-in and check-out times for a child, including absences.

core_entities.name: Payment
core_entities.description: A payment made by a guardian for daycare services, with amount, due date, and status.

core_entities.name: Invoice
core_entities.description: A bill issued to a guardian detailing charges for services, with line items and totals.

core_entities.name: Shift
core_entities.description: A work period assigned to a staff member, with start and end times.

core_entities.name: Activity
core_entities.description: A scheduled event or lesson in a classroom, such as nap time or educational play.

core_entities.name: PaymentPlan
core_entities.description: A billing plan associated with a child, defining frequency and rate for payments.

key_use_cases: Enroll a new child in the daycare
Register a guardian for a child
Assign a child to a classroom
Record daily attendance (check-in/check-out) for a child
Create and issue invoices to guardians
Update child medical or contact information
Generate reports on attendance, payments, or staff performance
assumptions: The daycare operates on a fixed schedule (e.g., weekdays, standard hours).
Guardians are responsible for payments, and each child has at least one guardian.
Staff have defined roles (e.g., teacher, assistant, admin) that affect permissions.
Attendance is tracked per child per day, with optional absence reasons.
Payments are linked to invoices, which itemize charges for services.
Classrooms have capacity limits and age-based groupings.
The system handles basic billing (invoices, payments) but not advanced accounting.
Medical information for children is stored for emergency purposes.
open_questions: Should the system support multiple payment plans (e.g., weekly, monthly, drop-in rates)?
How are late payments or discounts handled?
Is there a need for waitlist management for full classrooms?
Should staff have user accounts with login credentials for the app?
Are there regulatory requirements (e.g., child-to-staff ratios) to enforce?
How are holidays or daycare closures managed in scheduling and billing?
Should guardians have access to a portal to view attendance or make payments?
Is integration with external payment gateways (e.g., credit cards) required?
How long should historical attendance and payment records be retained?
